title: Reconstruction Accounts Receivable Worksheet: Overdue Draw Charge for a Fee Period
content:
The overdue draw charge on a Reconstruction contract is figured on the contract's most recently requested customer-funded draw, the customer-funded draw with the highest draw number.

**1. Unpaid amount.** The draw's unpaid amount is its requested amount less every payment posted toward it.

**2. Balance.** The balance the charge is figured on is the draw's unpaid amount.

**3. Charge.** The overdue draw charge is the tier's monthly overdue percentage of the draw's unpaid amount, rounded to the cent, half up.

**4. Order of assembly.** The overdue draw charge is put together in this order: first the chargeable balance, which is the balance the charge is figured on less every amount set against it, never below zero; then the monthly rate is applied to it; and only that result is rounded to the cent, half up.

The monthly overdue percentage is the contract's own agreement figure in the accounts receivable terms schedule.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Line | Figure |
|---|---|
| Requested amount of the draw | $12,000.00 |
| Payments posted toward it | $4,000.00 |
| Unpaid amount, the balance | $8,000.00 |
| Assumed monthly overdue percentage | 1.25% |
| Overdue draw charge: 1.25% of $8,000.00 | $100.00 |

Rounding comes last: an unpaid amount of $3,333.33 at an assumed 1.25% is $41.666625, charged as $41.67.
